records.issue_text: Module-level import() promises in packages/app-store/index.ts cache rejections forever: a single failed dynamic import poisons that app for the process lifetime with no top-level .catch, causing unhandled rejections on un-awaited reads of appStore entries
records.rationale: In `packages/app-store/index.ts`, each app entry is now initialized as a module-level `import("./...")` promise (e.g. `applecalendar: import("./applecalendar")`). These promises have no immediate `.catch()`. If any dynamic import rejects, that rejection is stored in `appStore[...]` and will remain rejected for the process lifetime; later code does `await appStore[...]` (e.g. `const calendarApp = await appStore[...]` in `getCalendar.ts`, and similar in `videoClient.ts` / payment code), so the app stays broken.
